key_results: Median DISCERN scores: Copilot 43, Perplexity 43, ChatGPT 36, Gemini 33; all failed sixth-grade readability threshold
comments: Qualitative assessment of LLM outputs; none of 124 default responses met readability standards for general public.

title: MedGenAgent: a closed-loop agent for oncology CT foundation model pretraining
task: Autonomously construct quality-controlled synthetic oncology CT for foundation model pretraining
key_results: MedGenAgent synthesized 11,159 CT samples (11,000 retained); pretrained model matched full-data baseline on three downstream tasks using 38.37% of data (4,400 real samples)
comments: Closed-loop agent iteratively curates synthetic dataset; addresses data scarcity and privacy in oncology CT; quality control via MedGemma automated.

model_io.model: MedGenAgent (MAISI synthesis + MedGemma QC + foundation model training + closed-loop feedback)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synthetic CT pretraining with automated quality control enables competitive foundation model performance with limited real data
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; synthetic pretraining + limited real-world fine-tuning matches full-data baseline

title: Cross-paradigm audit of large language model judges for clinical text evaluation
task: Audit LLM-as-judge reliability for German clinical text evaluation
key_results: Alignment with experts varied by corpus; no configuration reliable across paradigms; LLM-as-judge shifted 57.2% of pointwise categories, swapped 41.7% pairwise winners, missed 10.2% clinical errors; overrated criteria 'succinct' and 'accurate'
comments: LLM judges exhibited position/identity bias; cannot safely replace expert panels in clinical contexts; deployment requires decision-impact analysis.

model_io.model: Six open-weight LLMs evaluated as judges across three paradigms and four prompt configurations
inputs: German clinical texts (reports, nursing documentation, discharge summaries, patient letters)

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLM-as-judge provides reliable surrogate for expert evaluation in German clinical text assessment
hypotheses.result: Rejected; alignment varies; systematic biases present; 10.2% clinical error miss rate unacceptable

title: Evolutionary dynamics of adaptive introgression and balancing selection in domestic and wild Capra species

key_results: Confirmed goat–ibex hybrid and two backcross offspring (male F1 fertility); identified 8 candidate introgression regions predating domestication; found signatures of balancing selection confounding introgression detection
comments: Distinguishing ancient introgression from balancing selection is challenging; most shared haplotypes predate domestication.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pre-domestication introgression and balancing selection generate similar shared-haplotype signatures
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; both processes detected; most shared haplotypes predate domestication, enriched for olfaction/immunity genes
